title: Prerequisites: Node, Python, Git
description: Three one-line checks confirm the required tools before installing any agent CLI: Node 20+, Python 3.10+, and Git.

steps.description: Each line checks one prerequisite: node for Node-based tools, python3 for Python-based tools, and git which every tool assumes.
Line 1 notes you can skip to the container section if you prefer not to install Node on your host.

steps.question: What is the alternative if node is missing?
steps.answer: skip to §2c and run the tool in a container instead
